description: Reverse suspend_customer: the customer can sign in again and the failed-sign-in counter and lockout on the account are cleared. Their orders, carts and profile were kept during the suspension and stay as they are. Refused for a customer who is not suspended - for a lockout alone, unlock_customer, which also clears the sign-in rate limit. Returns the customer's account summary.
name: unsuspend_customer
title: Unsuspend customer
